# oodle_genai_llm_connection (Resource)

An LLM provider connection used by GenAI evaluators and experiments to call a model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider credential evaluators and experiments call a model with.
# The key is stored encrypted and is never returned by the API, so keep
# it out of source control — read it from a variable or a secret store.
resource "oodle_genai_llm_connection" "openai" {
  name          = "openai-prod"
  llm_provider  = "openai"
  api_key       = var.openai_api_key
  default_model = "gpt-4o-mini"
  is_default    = true

  custom_models = ["gpt-4o", "gpt-4o-mini"]

  default_params = jsonencode({
    temperature = 0
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the provider. The API stores this encrypted and never returns it, so Terraform cannot detect a key changed outside of Terraform.
- `llm_provider` (String) LLM provider identifier, for example 'openai', 'anthropic' or 'bedrock'.
- `name` (String) Name of the connection.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL to call instead of the provider's default endpoint.
- `custom_headers` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of extra HTTP headers to send to the provider. Stored encrypted and never returned.
- `custom_models` (List of String) Additional model names to expose for this connection.
- `default_model` (String) Model used when a caller does not name one.
- `default_params` (String) JSON object of default model parameters, for example {"temperature": 0}.
- `enable_default_models` (Boolean) Whether the provider's built-in model list is offered alongside custom_models.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the connection used when none is specified.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the LLM connection.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# LLM connections are imported by id.
terraform import oodle_genai_llm_connection.openai 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
